let rec fold f m accu =
      match m with
        Empty -> accu
      | Node(l, v, d, r, _) ->
          fold f r (f v d (fold f l accu))

module MakeOfMap (M: Extmap.S) = struct
  module M = M
  type elt = M.key
  type t = unit M.t

  let is_true b = if b then Some () else None

let disjoint = M.set_disjoint
  let iter f s = M.iter (fun e _ -> f e) s
  let fold f s acc = M.fold (fun e _ -> f e) s acc
  let for_all f s = M.for_all (fun e _ -> f e) s
  let exists f s = M.exists (fun e _ -> f e) s
  let filter f s = M.filter (fun e _ -> f e) s

let rec fold f s accu = match s with
    | Empty -> accu
    | Leaf (_, k,x) -> f k x accu
    | Branch (_, _,_,t0,t1) -> fold f t1 (fold f t0 accu)

let cardinal = M.cardinal
  let iter f t = M.iter (fun x _ -> f x) t
  let fold f t acc = M.fold (fun x _ acc -> f x acc) t acc
  let fold_left f acc t = M.fold_left (fun acc x _ -> f acc x) acc t
  let fold_right f t acc = M.fold_right (fun x _ acc -> f x acc) t acc
  let for_all p t = M.for_all (fun x _ -> p x) t
  let exists p t = M.exists (fun x _ -> p x) t
